_about: SYNTHETIC ground-truth eval set for the NEIGHBORHOOD-AWARE edge judge. Each case is a self-contained mini-overlay: an `anchor` node, a candidate note/task `N` (the edge under judgment is anchor->N), an explicit `neighborhood` (positive-weight JUDGED context edges + node text that lib/judge.expandNeighborhood walks from N), an optional `supersedeChain`, and a ground-truth `label` (keep|prune) with the relationship. The DISCRIMINATION cases pair a high-cosine, topically-similar-but-IRRELEVANT lookalike (label=prune) against a genuine structural prerequisite (label=keep) for the SAME anchor — cosine alone cannot tell them apart, the neighborhood can. taskTask cases additionally carry kind (context|blocking) and a dup case carries dup=true ground truth.

_schema.candidate: { key, title, summary, kind, cosine } — cosine = anchor<->N embedding similarity (the recall signal)
_schema.nodes: map key -> { title, summary } for every node referenced by neighborhood edges (resolver source)
_schema.edges: positive-weight JUDGED context edges [{from,to,weight}] forming N's neighborhood; expandNeighborhood walks these from N. anchor IS reachable here only for true positives.
_schema.supersedeChain: optional [{ key, title, summary, current }] — notes N replaced
_schema.label: keep | prune (ground truth on the keep-vs-prune decision)
_schema.kind: for taskTask keep cases: context | blocking (ground-truth edge kind)
_schema.dup: true if N is a re-plan duplicate of anchor (ground-truth supersedeTask)
